summary: Short corner kerb on a quiet street with homes 12-16 m away.
reasons: Quiet residential street, no parking convention
Corner lawn verge gives room beside lane

best_section.where: West kerb at the Highland Terrace corner, beside the grassy corner lot

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 12-16 m away on this side and more across the road; no bush or park backing.
drivers.access_and_room: Open sealed street; kerb-side lane with a grass corner verge, room to pull off the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street at a junction; low traffic.
drivers.convention: Signed 2P Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, resident permits excepted; a couple of cars park nearby, no camping seen.

flags: Gentle fall: about 3.7% over the best section, 4.8% mean over stretch
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees on the west side give some afternoon shade.
